m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: I knew it would eventually come to this. I might have helped you, you know. Atraydies will only do so if it suits the Binny Jezzerit.
I realize it would be impossible for me to remain lord at this point, but I will not compromise. Let us delay the inevitable no further.
Stay your hand, Wizard. I give. Mark my words, though. You've handed the lordship of House Tabbi to a puppet for the Binny Jezzerit.
I know not by what magic they control Atraydies, but he is oblivious. Watch when we return. The Revered Mother will decide my fate. You'll see.
It is disappointing... unfortunate even that you felt compelled to fight this to the finish, Count Crowl. It could have ended... peacefully.
The Count's course of action is regrettable if not tragic. I would join you to force his surrender, but that might just make matters worse.
Before we do this, let me say, though it may not please the Reverend Mother, I promise to abide by the Chronomaster's ruling in this matter.
Pol Atraydies. Do not be so hasty to renounce your claim. The Binny Jezzerit will ordain no one else...
Pardon me for interrupting, but this is unnecessary. Politics only hinders progress. I've studied the Chronoshard and my finding is clear.
Per the House history, Atraydies' claim is stronger. He is the proper lord. Now, before I go, I must say, I have concerns about the Chronoshard.
Pshah! And I expect you would take it to the Chronoverge for safekeeping? No. It belongs here... for now. Don't worry, I will look after it.
Very well, then. I'll take your word for it, Murdak, and I'd ask you all to excuse me. I have pressing matters to attend to at the Chronoverge.
I don't care what that stupid Chronoshard says, I will not step aside. I am the Lord of House Tabbi. As such, I'll be in the Lord's Retreat.
The Count has transgressed. For this, he must be brought to heel and then exiled.
Oh, but come now... no need to be cruel. Uh, er... Wizard, go convince the Count to surrender. He can remain in the Manor as a House retainer.
